seriesTitle: Taylor Swift: The End of an Era

episodes.title: Welcome to the Eras Tour
episodes.summary: Taylor recalls the development and rehearsals for the tour and preps for her run at Wembley Stadium.

episodes.title: Magic in the Eras
episodes.summary: Taylor and her crew use a two-month break to update the tour to add "THE TORTURED POETS DEPARTMENT."

episodes.title: Kismet
episodes.summary: As the tour heads back to the U.S., Taylor reminisces about her past and plans some new surprises.

episodes.title: Thank You for the Lovely Bouquet
episodes.summary: Taylor reflects on her acoustic sets, and welcomes Travis Kelce and Sabrina Carpenter to the stage.

episodes.title: Marjorie
episodes.summary: Taylor reveals how family inspired the tour and spotlights tour performers, including Gracie Abrams.

episodes.title: Remember This Moment
episodes.summary: Taylor reflects on the success and impact of The Eras Tour as she takes her final bow in Vancouver.
